title: SeaEval for Multilingual Foundation Models: From Cross-Lingual Alignment to Cultural Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual consistency and performance disparities by presenting semantically equivalent factual and reasoning questions (Cross-MMLU, Cross-LogiQA) across multiple languages to measure imbalanced multilingual proficiency.

Testing models on manually curated, region-specific datasets (US-Eval, SG-Eval, CN-Eval, PH-Eval) to evaluate their comprehension of local cultural practices, nuances, and values rather than relying on generalized or Western-centric knowledge.

Shuffling the positional arrangement of multiple-choice labels across datasets to measure the models' exposure bias and reliance on specific label orders (e.g., preference for option A or B) rather than the actual answer content.
